mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity( channel, name, start_time, end_time, description, type, discount, voucher, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{channel}, #{name}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{description}, #{type}, #{discount}, #{voucher}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET channel = #{channel}, name = #{name}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, description = #{description}, type = #{type}, discount = #{discount}, voucher = #{voucher}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
